purpose: Control/calibration records, including positive controls, near-miss controls, and scope guards.

entries.title: APOE ε4 and late-onset Alzheimer disease risk: non-deterministic robust genetic-risk control
limits: Not a deterministic or diagnostic claim.
Does not by itself demonstrate GWAS causation or clinical actionability.
Ancestry and risk-modifier literature require second-pass review.

entries.title: HLA-B*5701 / abacavir hypersensitivity: actionable pharmacogenomic positive control
limits: Predominantly abacavir/HLA-B*5701-specific; not generalizable to all gene-drug pairs.
Guideline date and current ARV practice need periodic review.
Clinical management remains necessary despite screening.

entries.title: ADH1B/ALDH2 alcohol-metabolism variants: biochemical-pathway positive control with population scope
limits: Alcohol flushing GWAS scope is East-Asian-ancestry males in the cited source.
Alcohol dependence and alcohol flushing are related but not identical phenotypes.
Social/cultural drinking context and health harms cannot be collapsed into genotype.

entries.title: HLA-B*15:02 / carbamazepine SJS/TEN risk: actionable but ancestry-scoped pharmacogenomic control
limits: No individual-level prescribing recommendation is made.
The label is one product/label surface, not a full CPIC/FDA/clinical-guideline review.
Uses ancestry descriptors as label language while flagging mixed ancestry and descriptor limits.

entries.title: PCSK9 loss-of-function variants: human-genetic positive control for strong effect and target plausibility
limits: The record uses PubMed abstract only in this pass; full article and therapy-development lineage need second pass.
Not a claim that all PCSK9 therapeutics or LDL interventions share identical effect/safety profiles.
Not a deterministic personal-risk record.

entries.title: GW150914 / LIGO gravitational-wave detection: surviving-anomaly positive control for anomaly discipline
limits: Positive control does not mature MKH-PAT-0017.
Open data and public code do not guarantee exact reproduction of the original internal workflow.
Control record is not a full GW150914 technical monograph.

entries.title: United Airlines Flight 232: CRM-positive control under catastrophic hydraulic loss
limits: Positive control does not mature MKH-PAT-0022.
Crew performance is not used to excuse design/inspection vulnerabilities.
The record requires full-report and recommendation-closure second pass before stronger synthesis.

entries.title: Viking Sky: near-grounding control for marine state-legibility and correction-infusion pattern
limits: Not a controlled success proof; the report still identifies serious design, operational, and organizational safety issues.
Does not prove recommendation implementation or industry-wide correction infusion.
Not a general statement about cruise-ship safety.
